name: 10541 · Mahopac, NY
findings: ZIP 10541 (Mahopac) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10541 (Mahopac) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
